integrity: Complete integer character/quotient graph computations, direct signed fixed-face Lefschetz checks for each of ten types, and complete acyclic matching for the known 405-sphere premise are supplied as independently runnable source files.
scientific_limitations: The representation result concerns the order-64 translation subgroup of the four-letter, three-coordinate Hamming scale-two Rips complex; does not cover full alphabet/coordinate automorphisms, integral representation lattices, quotient torsion, or other alphabet sizes. The nonequivariant 405-sphere homotopy type is previously known and is independently reverified as an input. Priority over unindexed work is not guaranteed.
title: Translation characters of the quaternary Hamming three-cube Rips complex
